definitions.explanation: The chief craftsman who directs sake brewing at a brewery and is responsible for its quality. Traditionally a seasonal worker from a farming region who led a team of brewers through the winter; famous groups include {南部杜氏|なんぶとうじ} and {越後杜氏|えちごとうじ}.

examples.japanese: {杜氏|とうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{造|つく}る→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The master brewer makes the sake.

examples.english: Recently more breweries have owners who serve as their own master brewer.

notes:
Also read とじ, an older reading. The team working under the {杜氏|とうじ} is called the {蔵人|くらびと}.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Brewing groups are named after their home regions: {南部杜氏|なんぶとうじ} (Iwate), {越後杜氏|えちごとうじ} (Niigata), {丹波杜氏|たんばとうじ} (Hyogo). Farmers once left home every winter to brew sake; today many brewers are year-round employees.
